plan.notes: Source: Springfield Technical Community College official 2025-26 Academic Catalog degree planner, Engineering Transfer - ENGR.AS (catalog.stcc.edu). Transcribed as the official semester sequence. Credit ranges resolved at minimum credits per project rule; 'Select one' option groups folded into choice slots with alternatives documented in choice_note/options. Course prerequisites are not stated in the planner grid and are not recorded. The catalog publishes program credits as a range (68-71); transcribed at the 68-credit minimum per project rule. Semester 1 "Select one" lists EGR-103 (3 cr) or CSC-113 (3 cr) with its lab CSC-113L (1 cr); transcribed at 3 credits. Semester 3/4 "Select one" groups include EL-MATH (3-4 cr, resolved at 3) and CET-210 (2 cr) listed with its lab CET-210L (2 cr); transcribed at 3 credits. Semester 4 math "Select one" includes MAT-255 (4 cr); transcribed at 3 credits. The catalog states the degree awarded is the Associate in Science in Engineering and Science Transfer.

courses.title: Behavioral/Social Science Elective
courses.choice_note: Catalog lists EL-SOC General Behavioral/Social Science Elective (3 credits); specific course not named.

courses.title: Engineering elective (select one)
courses.choice_note: Select one: EGR-103 Computer Applications in Engineering (3) or CSC-113 Intro to Python Programming (3) listed with its 1-credit lab CSC-113L. Transcribed at the 3-credit minimum; the CSC-113 path totals 4 credits with the lab.

courses.title: Science elective with lab (select one)
courses.choice_note: Select one lecture+lab pair: CHM-112/CHM-112L General Chemistry 2 or BIO-201/BIO-201L Biology 1. Catalog Note 1: BIO-201 should be selected by Computer, Electrical, and Mechanical Engineering majors going to UMass.

courses.title: Computing elective with lab (select one)
courses.choice_note: Select one lecture+lab pair: CSC-100/CSC-100L Introduction to Computer Science, CSC-101/CSC-101L Computer Science 1, or CSC-113/CSC-113L Intro to Python Programming. Catalog Note 2 (verbatim): "Computer and Electrical Engineers going to UMass should take CSC-111 while all other engineering majors going to UMass should take CSC-100."
